final: WITH item_city AS (SELECT il.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(il.product_price) AS price_avg, AVG(il.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(il.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS ratio_avg FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS il JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = il.order_item_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY il.order_item_id, c.town_city), city AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(price_avg) AS price_avg, AVG(ratio_avg) AS ratio_avg FROM item_city GROUP BY town_city), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) AS ratio_avg FROM city) SELECT city.town_city, city.price_avg, city.ratio_avg, city.ratio_avg - overall.ratio_avg FROM city JOIN overall ON overall.ratio_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE city.ratio_avg > overall.ratio_avg
